description: Board power tools on the Svelte 5 data grid, all from board config on the built-in card: a facet filter bar by tag and assignee through facets, card multi-select with bulk move through selectable, click or Ctrl-click and drag the group, a blocked flag from flagField that locks the card from moving, a card-age badge from ageField, and right-click menus on cards and lanes through cardMenu and laneMenu. Board and Table switcher included.

faq.question: How does bulk move work?
faq.answer: With selectable on, click or Ctrl-click marks several cards; dragging any selected card moves the whole set to the drop lane, and onCardMove is called for each so your data updates per card.

faq.question: What does the blocked flag do?
faq.answer: flagField names a truthy field; a blocked card shows a red badge with the field's value as the reason and is locked from drag and keyboard moves while flagBlocksMoves stays true.

faq.question: How are the menus defined?
faq.answer: cardMenu and laneMenu take item arrays or functions of the card or lane returning items, each with a label and an action; right-click opens them portalled next to the pointer.
